Unknown request or argument fields make a request invalid (library/callable-interface): an otherwise valid request of a known operation that carries an unknown or case-mismatched argument field returns status invalidRequest with a nonempty reason and changes no state. "Missing or invalid arguments of a known operation are refusals" covers a required argument that is missing, null or has an invalid type or value, not an extra, unknown field. A request without args, or with args that is not a JSON object, has an invalid request envelope ("args is an object") and also returns invalidRequest. A recorded review case or finding that requires refused for these cases is contradicted by this decision.

An otherwise admissible borrow whose due date (the borrowing date plus loanPeriodDays) would fall after 9999-12-31 is refused atomically: status refused with a nonempty reason, no result, no loan created and no state change. This follows from the date range of library/callable-interface (Gregorian years 0001 to 9999); no clamping, wrapping or year beyond 9999 is allowed. Every borrow whose due date stays within 9999-12-31 behaves as specified.
